results.question: How does the Telegram bot integration work?
results.gold_hint: Bot token + chat ID env vars; subtask completion notifications.
results.context_preview:
[fact] Nous telegram_bot.py: Standalone process (python -m nous.telegram_bot). Long-polls Telegram getUpdates. NousTelegramBot routes messages to _chat_streaming which POSTs to /chat/stream (SSE). StreamingMessage class handles progressive message editing with 1.2s rate-limiting. Supports /start, /new (session reset), /debug, /identity commands. Maintains _sessions dict mapping chat_id→session_id. Communicates with Nous only via REST API — no direct imports of core modules. Sanitizes markdown→HTML for Telegram formatting.

[fact] NOUS_SUBTASK_TOOL_CALL_LIMIT default = 20 (nous/config.py:256). Not overridable per-subtask (spawn_task has no max_tool_calls parameter). Not exposed in docker-compose.yml env list.
